title: Cloud Health (CLOHEA)
description: A multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform enabling medical facilities to manage staff and administrative workflows, live across multiple facilities. Led frontend architecture and optimized real-time data workflows to improve staff workspace operational speed.

title: Data Cleansing
description: A rule-based data quality platform for a government-scale civic dataset, built to validate and correct resident records at high volume. Delivered interactive systems enabling non-technical reviewers to manage  records better.

title: hashfree
description: An open-source JavaScript/TypeScript library that strips the # character from section links, producing clean, professional URLs for anchor navigation. Published to npm for use across any JS-based project needing hash-free in-page routing.

title: ii6pyro - Artist Site
description: An immersive web experience for an Afro-fusion artist based in Lagos, translating the artist's brand into a performant, animated digital presence. Built with WebGL and motion design to create a distinct, high-fidelity visual identity beyond a standard portfolio template.
